{{Quote|I don't care if it's a thermobaric burst or a superlaser. Indiscriminate military tactics are indefensible.|Leia|<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery-Thermobaric launcher (SPHA-F)''' was a version of the [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery/Legends|Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], specifically by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. It was equipped with a high-angle parabolic launcher, which was capable of discharging a projectile that would ignite the surrounding atmosphere at the point of impact, generating a brief but apocalyptic firestorm. The Rebel leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], whose [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] had been [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the Empire earlier, expressed disgust at the last statement in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' due to it being an indiscriminate military tactic, not caring if it was a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] or a [[thermobaric burst]].
